title: Check: Effect of Catalysts on Rate (2)

questions.stem: Enzymes are biological catalysts. What makes them different from many industrial catalysts?

options.text: Enzymes are used up during the reaction
Enzymes are highly specific, each catalysing only one particular reaction
Enzymes increase the enthalpy change of reactions
Enzymes work by increasing temperature in cells

questions.explanation: Enzymes are protein catalysts that are highly specific - each enzyme catalyses only one particular reaction or type of reaction. They also work at low temperatures (body temperature, around 37°C) and are sensitive to temperature and pH changes, unlike many industrial catalysts.
